data.name: Humani Project
data.detailed_description:
Humanity has been desecrated.

400 years after the devastating Human-Robot wars, the remnants of man struggle to survive - hunted by the mistakes of the past, and the machines of the future.

In Humani Project, you explore a beautiful yet dangerous post-apocalyptic world. Traverse a lush underground forest, blistering volcano, or even the choking depths of the ocean. Every power-up you discover feels deeply tied to the world around you — ancient relics that unlock new abilities, hidden paths, and deeper secrets.

Classic Metroidvania gameplay meets comic-book pixel art:

  • Fluid movement and satisfying exploration

  • Interconnected world filled with secrets and multiple paths

  • Meaningful upgrades that expand your capabilities

  • Atmospheric storytelling through environmental narrative

Rebuild what was lost. Uncover the truth behind the fall of humanity. Only you can decide what comes next.

Aeth-Novara is in your hands.

data.short_description: 400 years after the Human-Robot wars of 199X, the remaining humans are being hunted down and forced into pockets of semi-civilization. The robots have already repurposed most of the remaining humans into living batteries. Will you be next?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized Metroidvania-style combat in which enemies briefly break apart into their component materials (fur and bones, feathers, leaves, metal and bolts, etc.) when defeated. There is mild language (occasional use of words such as “hell” and “damn”).  

The story involves a corrupted AI that turns machines against humanity, including themes of war and the long-term consequences of AI deciding that humans are holding civilization back. There are also mild psychological/horror elements, such as the player character having no memory and occasionally experiencing glitchy visions of faces saying “help me.”

There is no sexual content, nudity, realistic gore, self-harm, or depictions of drug abuse. There are currently no depictions of alcohol use (this may change in future updates).
